official_title: TxDMV Form 130-U: Application for Texas Title and/or Registration

columns.format_notes: 17-character VIN (strictly synthetic 1TEST00000A00000x in examples). Keep in one column; merge comb boxes when using flat/older revisions.
4-digit vehicle model year.
Vehicle manufacturer make (uppercase standard for TxDMV).
Standard TxDMV 2-character body style code (e.g., PK, 4D, LL, UT, VN).
Vehicle model designation.
Primary exterior color.
Whole miles only—do not include tenths of a mile.
Curb/empty weight in pounds (required for commercial vehicles and trailers).

columns.pdf_field_example: 16 Applicant First Name or Entity Name Middle Name Last Name Suffix if any
columns.format_notes: Buyer individual legal name or business entity name.

columns.pdf_field_example: 18 Applicant Mailing Address City State Zip
columns.format_notes: Street address (concatenate with city, state, ZIP for Box 18).

columns.pdf_field_example: 18 Applicant Mailing Address City State Zip
columns.format_notes: Applicant mailing city.

columns.pdf_field_example: 18 Applicant Mailing Address City State Zip
columns.format_notes: 2-letter state abbreviation.

columns.pdf_field_example: 18 Applicant Mailing Address City State Zip
columns.format_notes: 5-digit ZIP code (keep as Text).
Texas county name (e.g., TRAVIS, HARRIS, DALLAS).

columns.pdf_field_example: 20 Previous Owner Name or Entity Name City State
columns.format_notes: Selling dealership or prior titled owner name.
Texas General Distinguishing Number (synthetic P000001 in examples).
Gross vehicle sales price.
Trade-in credit deducted from taxable sales price ($0.00 if none).

columns.pdf_field_example: 34 First Lienholder Name if any Mailing Address City State Zip
columns.format_notes: First lienholder institution name (or NONE for cash sales).
Lien creation date MM/DD/YYYY (leave blank when lienholder_name is NONE).
